name: Reijou no Kangoku
source:
Kyoya is now standing in front of a house. As a matter of fact, he and his mother was living there ten years ago, but they were kicked out of the house by Kanemitsu. After that, his mother passed away in poverty. Yes, Kyoya is now back to take revenge on them... Kanemitsu is already dead, but there are Masato, his son, Kotono, Masato's younger sister, Mizuki, Masato's fiancee, Mio, a maid and Sayoko, Kanemitsu's second wife. While he pretends to be a good man outwardly, he entraps them one by one...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
恭也此刻正站在一栋宅邸前。事实上，十年前他与母亲曾住在这里，却被金光赶了出去。此后，母亲在贫困中去世。没错，恭也如今正是回来向他们复仇…金光已经死亡，但宅邸里还有他的儿子真人、真人的妹妹琴乃、真人的未婚妻瑞希、女仆美绪，以及金光的继室小夜子。恭也表面上装作善良正直，暗中却把他们一个接一个诱入陷阱…

[摘自ErogeShop]
